author: Claude Code (sole code writer)
exposure: Adaptive development on an inspected train set: the implementer saw Task010/Task011 train results (incl. the PUMP-04 flow-noise alert detail quoted in the packet). All formulas, ranges, thresholds and gates come from docs/tasks/012-hydraulic-spread.md; phase 1 read no benchmark telemetry, snapshots or labels.

data_scope.allowed_shared_static: assets.csv parsed then filtered to train rows; shared parquet via train predicates (asserted); benign filtered to train
forbidden: test PUMP-10..12 telemetry, snapshots, predictions, labels

emission: unchanged causal B1 (k=6, persistence 15, 24 h reference, 12 h refractory), PYTHONHASHSEED=0 at start

candidates.V3: H3; on hydraulic abstention (any outcome other than emitted) and B1 UNKNOWN, unchanged Task010 W1 rule; else exact B1
candidates.V5: H5 with the same UNKNOWN-only W1 refinement

not_evaluated: B1 COMMUNICATION_LOSS / SENSOR_STUCK (protected, outcome not_evaluated_protected); B1 CAVITATION / AIR_ENTRAINMENT (unsupported: b1_cavitation_or_air_entrainment)

assumptions.head: equal tap elevations, velocity-head difference ignored

inputs.observed: installed in passport, closed-minute count >= 30, finite mean, finite std >= 0; measured rpm only (no inferred speed)
inputs.passport: pump_rated_flow_m3_h Qb, pump_rated_head_m Hb, pump_shutoff_head_m H0, motor_rated_rpm nr, npsh3_at_bep_m; all finite > 0, H0 > Hb

applicability_gates_in_order: alert minute end >= first-24h reference end
Q > 0 and q = Q/(r Qb) in [0.3, 1.3]
Hcurve = H0 r^2 - (H0-Hb)(Q/Qb)^2 > 0 and Hobs = (Pd-Ps)*1000/(rho g) > 0
Pv from first matching Antoine row (TK = T + 273.15), no extrapolation
NPSHa_lower = (101.325 + Ps - Pv)*1000/(rho g) >= 1.5 * NPSH3, NPSH3 = NPSH3b r^2 (0.55 + 0.45 q^2.6)
antoine_formula: log10(P_bar) = A - B/(TK + C); Pv_kPa = 100 P_bar; first row containing TK; gaps 303-304 K and 333-334 K and outside 273-373 K unsupported

budget.reference_floor: median source std over steady closed minutes ending <= first-24h reference end; minute eligible if source installed, count >= 30, finite mean, finite std >= 0; >= 60 eligible minutes, else source reference_unsupported
budget.note: conservative sum of magnitudes; no independence or statistical bound claimed

eligibility: source in {Q, Ps, Pd}: causal zs_source > 6 AND sigma_source / budget_source > factor (3.0 or 5.0); exactly one eligible -> SENSOR / SENSOR_NOISE_SPIKES on that channel; zero or several -> exact B1; a reference-unsupported source cannot be eligible
structural_note: For factor >= 1 two sources cannot be simultaneously eligible, because each budget includes the other's measured spread; the abstained_ambiguous branch is a defensive guard only (not fixture-forced). Two noisy sources therefore abstain (abstained_no_source).
confidence: retained B1 anomaly score (uncalibrated), not a confidence for the newly named cause

output_schema.diagnosis_source: emitting rule: B1, H3, H5 or W1
output_schema.rule_detail: JSON on every row of H/V candidates: evaluated_rule, emitted_source, outcome (emitted / abstained_no_source / abstained_ambiguous / unsupported / not_evaluated_protected), unsupported_reason, measured inputs with units/counts, passport, operating point, curve heads, NPSH values, derivatives, per-source physical contributions, reference floor and minutes, budget, ratio, spread z and status, assumptions
output_schema.evidence: only the emitting rule's explanation (H: values in native units, budget decomposition, gates, assumptions, limits; W1: snapshot provenance)

gates.success: detected>=18, class>=14, false+excess<=6, sensor type+channel>=3, AND (type>=10 OR (type>=9 AND sensor type+channel>=4))
gates.selection: useful diagnoses desc, correct type desc, false+excess asc, H3 < H5 < V3 < V5
correctness: control semantic equality and expected metrics

prefix replay + future mutation of minute means, std/min/max, counts (set to 0) and snapshots completing after the cut, for ALL candidates, at every alert, reference end -1/0/+1/+60 s, 3 snapshot completion/age boundaries -1/0/+1 s per asset, 5 random cuts (rng 0); every output column incl. rule_detail
main prediction hash equals a fresh PYTHONHASHSEED=0 child
reported: applicability_coverage.csv (outcome / unsupported reason per candidate and asset)

runner.attempts: new results/hydraulic_spread/run-<UTC>/ per attempt; partial runs preserved; COMPLETED.json blocks a second score

review: docs/tasks/012-review-round1.md addressed: reference floor requires finite mean; counts mutated for all candidates; two-noisy-source fixture abstains (no forced ambiguity)
